subject.title: [优化建议] 添加结构化错误处理和智能重试机制

question: Which npm installer failures should OpenClaw auto-retry or auto-repair, and which should only print remediation guidance?
rationale: Current source shows a real diagnostics and recovery gap, but retrying network errors, repairing npm prefixes, and making optional probes strict can change first-run and upgrade behavior across platforms.

options.title: Define narrow policy, then implement
options.body: Classify known npm failures, retry only idempotent transient network errors, and add platform-specific EACCES guidance or repair with focused Bash and PowerShell tests.

options.title: Guidance-only diagnostics
options.body: Keep install behavior mostly unchanged but improve EACCES, ENOSPC, EBADENGINE, and network-error messages with clear next commands and docs links.

options.title: Keep current partial diagnostics
options.body: Accept the current npm code/syscall/errno output and targeted cleanup retries without adding a broader installer error policy.

recommendation.title: Define narrow policy, then implement
recommendation.body: Classify known npm failures, retry only idempotent transient network errors, and add platform-specific EACCES guidance or repair with focused Bash and PowerShell tests.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest available recent history across the installer, release, docs, and Docker setup surfaces implicated by this issue.
